title: Three yes/no array helpers
why_it_matters: They replace clumsy loops with a single readable line.
explanation: includes checks if a value is in the array. some asks whether at least one item passes a test. every asks whether all of them do. Each returns a plain true or false, so they fit right inside an if.
code:
const scores = [40, 75, 90];
console.log(scores.some((s) => s > 80));   // true
console.log(scores.every((s) => s >= 50)); // false
console.log(scores.includes(75));          // true
try_it: Check whether every item in a list of prices is above zero.
